_comment: Mock server settings; on the real server they come from the admin panel via Nakama storage. attendance.fine_tiers: the n-th workday missed in a row costs `percent` of the balance, rounded up, never below zero; the first missed day only breaks the streak. photo: coins the partner gets for confirming a joint photo, and how the mock simulates the other phone. raffle: parking draw on the last Friday of every month.
